outer folds.what it is: folds of the outer cross-validation; each is held out once per repeat

outer seeds.what it is: one seed per repeat of the outer cross-validation

inner folds.what it is: folds inside each outer training part that choose the settings of a method

list sizes.what it is: list lengths offered to the two ranking methods

L1 shares.what it is: mix of the elastic-net penalty; 1 is pure LASSO, 0 pure ridge

path length.what it is: penalties per path of LASSO-Cox and elastic-net Cox

path depth.what it is: smallest penalty of a path as a share of the largest

longest list.what it is: longest list a penalty path may offer

ridge grid.what it is: ridge penalties offered to the scoring model

clinical ridge.what it is: ridge on the clinical columns of the scoring model, a numerical safeguard

leakage list size.what it is: list length of the one-gene Cox ranking in the leakage and shuffled-outcome checks

shuffle seeds.what it is: one seed per shuffle of the outcomes in the shuffled-outcome check

expressed log2.what it is: a gene is expressed in a patient at this log2(TPM + 1) or above

expressed share.what it is: share of training patients in which a gene must be expressed to pass the filter

Uno horizon (years).what it is: Uno's C counts pairs up to this time after diagnosis

clinical levels.what it is: indicator columns of the clinical model per covariate; the most common level is the reference

forms.what it is: the two forms of the scoring model and their key in the saved runs

arms.what it is: the two ways of selecting that the leakage check contrasts

selection methods.what it is: the four methods that are candidates for the choice at the end
